warnings: Three small unmarked members of S-12 (no scale printed under them): element_id null + element_name_assigned (§0.2); element_type follows the corpus precedent — lintel and sill band 'beam', corbel 'connection_detail' (houses 156, 159).

Lintel conflict, recorded not resolved: this general lintel 'ขยายทับหลังทั่วไป' is 0.15 x 0.20 with 2-ø9 top + 2-ø9 bottom and 1ป-ø6mm@0.15 m, while the door/window schedules A-10 / A-11 (หน้า11-12) print the lintel over those openings as 'ทับหลัง ค.ส.ล. 0.15x0.25 ม. เหล็กเสริม 9 มม. 4 เส้น ปลอก 6 มม. @0.15 ม.' Same bars and ties, 50 mm deeper. The S-12 detail is the general case, the schedule is opening-specific, so neither overrides the other (§7 section-wins applies to one mark, and neither is a mark); both kept, flagged lintel_depth_differs_from_door_window_schedule.

เอ็นใต้หน้าต่าง: depth 0.10, width printed only as 'L — ระยะเท่ากับผนังฉาบ' (equal to the plastered wall thickness) → width_mm null, never guessed. Its 2-RB9 lie side by side in the flat section, so they go in bar_layers[] with no top/bottom face (house 159 precedent).

หูช้างรับแผ่นพื้น is drawn against beam B4 (projection 0.10, top step 0.05, nose 0.10, sloping soffit; RB9mm@0.15m hooked from the beam + one RB6mm longitudinal bar). The S-03 plan prints the corbels at the Cx posts on row B ('หูช้างรับแผ่นพื้น (+3.60)', z level +3.60) — both locations noted on the element. Its 0.10 / 0.05 / 0.10 and the lintel/sill sizes are element-internal (§4 rule 4). Extracted in the 2026-10-22 resume run.
